dialogues.jp:
学力はあるが体力のない音夢にとっては、ここ
までくると休憩時間は体力回復の場でしかない。
dialogues.en:
Nemu has a brain, but she doesn't have enough energy. Break
time's only to get enough energy back again.
dialogues.text:
Nemu has a brain, but she doesn't have enough energy. Break
time's only to get enough energy back again.

dialogues.jp:
「甘いものを食べると元気になるし、頭も働くっ
　て言うけど、いるか？」
dialogues.en:
"They say sweets will help rejuvenate you and make your
brain work, so do you want some?"
dialogues.text:
"They say sweets will help rejuvenate you and make your
brain work, so do you want some?"

dialogues.jp: なんとなく、伏せた頭をなでながら頷く。
dialogues.en: I patted her head as she lay on the desk face down.
dialogues.text: I patted her head as she lay on the desk face down.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「やめて〜、覚えたことが頭のてっぺんから抜
　けてくよ〜」
dialogues.en:
"Stop that. Everything I memorized will go out the top of my
head."
dialogues.text:
"Stop that. Everything I memorized will go out the top of my
head."

dialogues.jp:
表情は分からないが、嬉しそうなオーラを発し
ているので、なでるのはやめない。
dialogues.en:
I can't see her face, but she seems happy, so I continue to
pat her head.
dialogues.text:
I can't see her face, but she seems happy, so I continue to
pat her head.

dialogues.jp:
そっ、と目をこちらにむける音夢の耳元に、顔
を近づける。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked at me, and I move right next to her ears.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked at me, and I move right next to her ears.

dialogues.jp:
ガタッ、と席を立とうとして、音夢が机の角に
足をぶつける。
dialogues.en:
Nemu hit her leg at the corner of her desk, as she tries to
stand up.
dialogues.text:
Nemu hit her leg at the corner of her desk, as she tries to
stand up.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Ha ha, that should wake you up."
dialogues.text: "Ha ha, that should wake you up."

dialogues.jp: これ以上は危険と判断して自分の席に戻る。
dialogues.en:
I went back to my desk, thinking it would be dangerous to go
any further.
dialogues.text:
I went back to my desk, thinking it would be dangerous to go
any further.

dialogues.jp:
悔しそうに自分の椅子に座りなおす音夢に微
笑んで、小さく鼻歌を歌いながら、次の教科
のノートに目を落とした。
dialogues.en:
I smiled at Nemu as she sat down at her desk looking
mortified, and I looked down at my notebook while singing to
myself.
dialogues.text:
I smiled at Nemu as she sat down at her desk looking
mortified, and I looked down at my notebook while singing to
myself.

dialogues.jp:
学力はあるが体力のない音夢。伏せた頭をなで
ながら励ましてやる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu has a brain, but doesn't have enough energy. I pat on
her head to cheer her up.
dialogues.text:
Nemu has a brain, but doesn't have enough energy. I pat on
her head to cheer her up.

dialogues.jp:
音夢は嫌といいつつも、嬉しそうなオーラを発
していた。
dialogues.en: Nemu said no, but she was giving out a happy vibe.
dialogues.text: Nemu said no, but she was giving out a happy vibe.

dialogues.jp:
眠そうにしているので、耳元で『可愛いよ』と
｛ささや／囁｝いて目を覚まさせたあと、自分の席へと戻っ
た。
dialogues.en:
She looked sleepy, so I whispered "you're cute" into her ear
to wake her up and went back to my own desk.
dialogues.text:
She looked sleepy, so I whispered "you're cute" into her ear
to wake her up and went back to my own desk.
